correct_completion: we missed the first part of the film.
full_sentence: Because the train was late, we missed the first part of the film.
acceptable_variants: we missed the beginning of the film.
we had to wait outside the cinema for a long time.

options.text: we arrived at the cinema early.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the cause: a late train makes an early arrival unlikely, so the result does not follow from the stem.

options.text: the train was not very comfortable.
options.why_wrong: This describes the train but does not give a consequence of the delay, so the cause-effect relation is missing.

options.text: we missed the first part of the film.
so we decided to walk home slowly.
options.why_wrong: 'So' expresses a result and creates a double connector with 'because', which makes the sentence ungrammatical.

explanation: After 'because', the stem gives the cause, so the completion must describe the effect of that cause in the main clause. Learners should avoid adding a second connector such as 'so' in the same sentence.
translation: Porque o trem estava atrasado, perdemos a primeira parte do filme.
